_README: Written by scripts/record_cassettes.py (M1-14). The prompt bundle version is the thing analysis cassettes are keyed to: a prompt edit changes it, and every analysis cassette recorded under the old one is stale. Each cassette also carries the sha of its own request and replay refuses a mismatch, so a stale cassette fails loudly instead of replaying the wrong prompt's answer under the new prompt's version.
